title: Reset Password
content: Users can reset passwords from Settings > Security > Reset Password.

title: Refund Policy
content: Refund requests are processed within 5 business days after approval.

title: Subscription Upgrade
content: Users can upgrade subscriptions from the billing dashboard.

title: Two Factor Authentication
content: 2FA can be enabled from security settings using authenticator apps.

title: Account Deletion
content: Users can permanently delete accounts from profile settings.

title: Payment Failure
content: If payment fails, users should retry using another payment method.

title: Support Contact
content: Users can contact support through support@example.com.

title: Profile Update
content: Users can update profile information from account settings.
